about: The voices a first sketch reaches for: each one measured from real recordings or fitted against a record, so a newcomer's first sound is never a console patch. guide shows this list to a new person, voices_list marks these with *, and sketch builds only from them. Add a voice when it is measured and has passed an ear test. A voice with `needs` plays samples fetched on the person's word (samples_fetch); until then sketch uses its `standin` and says so.

voices.name: violin
voices.why: mimic profile, 10 notes measured (VSCO 2 CE, CC0)

voices.name: cello
voices.why: mimic profile, 9 notes measured (flcellogrl, CC BY 4.0)

voices.name: contrabass
voices.why: mimic profile, 5 notes measured (VSCO 2 CE, CC0)

voices.name: clarinet
voices.why: mimic profile, 11 notes measured (VSCO 2 CE, CC0); ear check 10-07: not told from the recording

voices.name: bassoon
voices.why: mimic profile, 19 notes measured (VSCO 2 CE, CC0); ear check 10-07: good enough

voices.name: horn
voices.why: mimic profile, 29 notes measured (VSCO 2 CE, CC0); ear check 10-07: good enough, a little synthetic

voices.name: kit70
voices.why: modal kit fitted against a late-60s record's drum stem

voices.name: strat70_rhythm
voices.why: waveguide guitar fitted to a late-60s record (its lead notes passed a blind exam 20 of 22)

voices.name: strat70_clean
voices.why: the same fitted guitar played single notes through a clean amp (its lead notes passed a blind exam 20 of 22)

voices.name: pbass70
voices.why: waveguide bass fitted to the same record's bass stem

voices.name: sub_bass
voices.why: a sub bass is a sine by nature: the one synth a sketch uses

voices.name: growl
voices.why: designed by ear: electronic (dubstep) only, never in an acoustic sketch

voices.name: rhodes
voices.why: a real 1977 Rhodes Mark I, sampled (jRhodes3d, Jeff Learman), through amp, pan tremolo and chorus

voices.name: rusty
voices.why: a real 1980s kit, sampled (Big Rusty Drums, Karoryfer, CC0): velocity layers, round robins, its mics

voices.name: emily
voices.why: a real clean electric guitar, sampled (Emilyguitar, Karoryfer, CC0), through a clean amp and a pingpong delay

voices.name: crackle
voices.why: designed vinyl surface noise: clicks and hiss, under the whole sketch

never_first: the other synth presets (the sprite `synth` type): a first sketch on them sounds like a game console
gaps: an organ (a pipe or Hammond voice; the piano stands in)
a singing voice (vox is in progress)
more winds and brass (flute, oboe, sax, trumpet, trombone, tuba: measured, not yet past the ear)
